comparison.objective: Lever a heavy block upward, insert a chock, and transfer load onto it; candidate tunes and locks a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual lever-force application and under-load chock placement versus small-tool manipulation and iterative impact-response adjustment.
comparison.success_condition: Two-kilogram block rests safely on the chock after bar release versus safe stopping across two cycles with setting retention. No separate specs or lift/chock tolerances are given.
comparison.reason: Load lifting and support transfer test different mechanics from damping calibration.
